title: Normalised CIM value (Stage 2 output)
description: Stage 2's output: every extracted.schema.json entry, mapped to a template row and rescaled to the client config's reporting unit. This is what stage 3 renders into the review workbook.

template_row.description: The target row key in the Excel template's entry-cell map, per config.row_map. Usually identical to `row` but kept distinct so a client's mapping can rename or combine lines without touching the extraction contract.

value_scaled.description: The value converted to config.reporting_unit (e.g. always millions), regardless of the unit it was originally reported in. Preserves the raw `value`/`unit` above for audit.
